title: Product review of the Champro Z-Screen.  Champro Sports heavy duty/industrial Z-Screen.
description: Coach Twigg discusses the Champro Baseball and Softball Z-Screen, why he thinks that is a great choice for all of you, and why he chose this screen for himself, over all the others (when he has already lost one of his eyes from using a different, cheaper, and less reliable L-Screen).
tags: L-Screens and how to use them
